a.lede: Pre-orders for the Atari-licensed THE 800XL began today. This is a modernized yet claimed to be faithful recreation of the classic 8-bit home computer, popular in the early 1980s.
a.title: The Atari 800XL returns with a 'faithful' but modern Retro Games Ltd redesign

b.lede: This updated version connects via HDMI and comes with 25 built-in games.
b.title: The Atari 800XL hybrid gaming console is back after decades in obscurity
